import java.io.BufferedReader;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.io.InputStreamReader;
import java.io.PrintWriter;
import java.util.StringTokenizer;

public class EducationalRound86E {

	public static long mod = 998244353;
	public static int max = (int)4e5+10;
	public static long[] fact;
	public static long[] infact;
	
	public static void precompute() {
		fact = new long[max];
		infact = new long[max];
		fact[0] = fact[1] = infact[0] = infact[1] = 1;
		for(int i = 2; i < max; i++) {
			fact[i] = (fact[i - 1] * (long)i)%mod;
			infact[i] = (infact[i - 1] * (long)modInverse(i, mod))%mod;
		}
	}
	
	public static long nCr(int n, int r) {
		long ans = fact[n] * infact[r];
		ans %= mod;
		ans *= infact[n - r];
		ans %= mod;
		return ans;
	}
	
	public static long fast(long a, long n) {
		if(n == 0) return 1L;
		long ans = fast(a, n/2L);
		ans = ans * ans;
		ans %= mod;
		if(n%2 == 1) {
			ans = ans * a;
			ans %= mod;
		}
		return ans;
	}
	
	public static void solve() {
		precompute();
		int n = sc.nextInt();
		long k = sc.nextLong();
		if(k == 0) {
			out.println(fact[n]);
			return;
		}
		if(n <= k) {
			out.println(0);
			return;
		}
		long ans = nCr(n, (int)k);
		int cols = n - (int)k;
		long sum = 0;
		for(int i = 0; i <= cols; i ++) {
			long tempans = nCr(cols, i);
			tempans *= fast(cols - i, n);
			tempans %= mod;
			if((i&1)==1) {
				sum -= tempans;
				if(sum < 0) sum += mod;
			}else {
				sum+=tempans;
				if(sum >= mod) sum -= mod;
			}
		}
		out.println((2 * ((ans * sum)%mod))%mod);
	}

		out = new PrintWriter(new java.io.BufferedWriter(System.out));
		sc = new FastReader();
		solve();
		out.close();
	}

		long gcd;
		long x;
		long y;

			this.gcd = gcd;
			this.x = x;
			this.y = y;
		}
	}

		if (a == 0) {
			return new Triplet(b, 0, 1);

			//System.out.println("Multiplicative inverse doesnot exist");
			return -1;

		StringTokenizer st;

			br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
		}

		String next() {

				} catch (IOException e) {
					e.printStackTrace();
				}
			}
			return st.nextToken();
		}

		int nextInt() {
			return Integer.parseInt(next());
		}

		double nextDouble() {
			return Double.parseDouble(next());

			try {
				str = br.readLine();

				e.printStackTrace();
			}
			return str;
